messages:
nora: Heads-up — customer flagged a silent autofallback during a canary. Console just shows "fallback occurred" with no operator trail. Need visibility and a compact playback.

ishan: +1. Our current telemetry only emits a single event. Playback should present an ordered sequence: metric trigger -> policy evaluation -> decision -> model switch -> follow-up metrics. Each step needs a short payload and evidence link.

rita: Compliance: some customers require 180d unredacted audits; others require immediate PII redaction. We need per-account retention and redaction_level (none|partial|full), and RBAC gating for unredacted views.

nora: UX sketch: add an "Operator trail" inline in Rollouts. Small timeline pill that expands into a scrubber with labeled steps (metric, rule, decision, model). Steps are filterable by reason (latency/error/quota). Each step can expand to show a compact payload and an evidence link.

ishan: Telemetry proto sketch (internal, compact):

```json
POST /v1/audit/fallback
{
  "event": "fallback_decision",
  "trace_id": "t-546-b",
  "time": "2026-08-01T09:11:22Z",
  "policy_id": "auto-latency-v2",
  "matched_rule": "latency>180ms",
  "from_model": "redwood-xl",
  "to_model": "redwood-small",
  "operator": "auto",
  "attribution_mode": "mixed_kv",
  "segments_ref": "s3://rbw/segments/t-546-b.json",
  "evidence_ref": "s3://rbw/evidence/t-546-b/",
  "policy_snapshot": "s3://rbw/policy/auto-latency-v2.json"
}
```

rita: Note: per payload size rules don't inline big arrays in the event. Use segments_ref and have the indexer fetch and store a compact view for Console. Also include estimated_share when mixed attribution is set.

chris: Billing: we need an official signed reconcile endpoint for disputes (GET /v1/billing/trace/{id}/official_breakdown) that returns per-segment token counts and unit rates at serve-time. Also add an alert when autofallback-driven model shifts >15% of billed tokens MoM for an account.

log-bot: Deploy: canary rollout of 'auditable-fallback' started 2026-08-05T14:02Z :rocket:

nora: Edge-case: prefix replay + KV cache can cause tokens to be partially served by origin host; playback must show per-span attribution using trace-span ids so UI can stitch exact vs estimated segments.

ishan: Implementation owners: telemetry/indexer (ishan), console playback (nora), compliance/RBAC (rita), billing/reconcile (chris). I'll open RF-5567 with the proto and a small mock.

nora: Thanks — filing ticket and adding runbook link.
